overview.description: The Direxion Daily Robotics, Artificial Intelligence & Automation Index Bull 2X ETF (UBOT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund offers 2x daily leveraged exposure to a market-cap-selected and -weighted index of robotics and artificial intelligence companies from developed countries. UBOT was launched on Apr 19, 2018 and is issued by Direxion.
